    <div class="call-us-txt">
        <h2 class="boxtitle">Kiteboarding</h2>
        <p>Consistent wind, shallow water and unlimited access make Cape Hatteras, North Carolina one of the top kiteboarding destinations in the world. Watermen’s Retreat is waterfront at “The Slick”, the premier flat water kiteboarding location in Cape Hatteras. We’re located directly beside <a href="http://www.realwatersports.com/kiteboarding" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">REAL Watersports, the #1 kiteboarding school and outfitter in the world.</a></p>

        <h2 class="boxtitle">What is 5-star Kiting?</h2>
        <p>When you take an amazing location and add a private launch, air compressors, gear lockers and friendly knowledgeable staff to help you launch, it’s no wonder that Watermen’s Retreat is consistently voted a 5-star kiteboarding resort. Whether you are bringing your own gear or would prefer to rent gear we’ve got you covered.</p>

    <div class="call-us-txt">
        <h2 class="boxtitle">Learn To Kiteboard</h2>
        <p>Watermen’s Retreat is located directly beside REAL Watersports and the <a href="http://www.realwatersports.com/lessons/kiteboarding" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">REAL Lesson Center</a>. REAL has been teaching kiteboarding since the beginning, with over 50,000 students worldwide. Whether it’s beginner instruction, jumping, foiling, or waveriding, the coaches at REAL are ready to take you to the next level.</p>

<div class="simple-text-1 ">
	<div class="container">
        <article>
            <p><iframe width="1243" height="699" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/NTKD3u-KxQs" title="Epic downwinder with huge land gaps!" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe></p>

</div><section class="faqDroper  FQ-1 ">
                <div class="questionList">    
        	        	                        <div class="questionCat">
                                                    <h3 class="catTitle">KITEBOARDING FAQ</h3>
                                                <ul class="drops ">                          
                        	                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Is it windy all the time?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Historical data shows that we average over 20 days of kiteable wind per month and 22-28 days per month in the summer (more than 16mph).</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">Is the launch spot busy?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Our private launch is reserved for REAL lessons and camps, and guests at Watermen's Retreat. It’s uncrowded, friendly and there is always someone to help you launch and land.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What about on the water?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>The kiting opportunities from Watermen’s Retreat are limitless. The Slick, our flat water paradise, is just upwind. Numerous downwinders finish right in our backyard. The “Watermen’s Foil Garden”, featuring the perfect depth water for kite and wing foiling, is located right off our dock. This is kiteboarding perfection.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	        <li class="">
                        	            <h5><span class="question_text">What is The Planet Run?</span><span class="open_btn"><i class="fa fa-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></h5>
                        	            <article>
                        	                <p>Eight miles of total insanity! The Planet of the Apes (or Planet Run) is the best kiteboarding downwinder in the world. Flat water slicks, land gaps, and miles of uncrowded mega loops, make this a “must do” session while kiting Cape Hatteras. There’s only one way to make it better...and that’s ending it with a cold Carolina Brewery beer at Watermen’s Bar &amp; Grill.</p>                            
                        	            </article>                        
                        	        </li>
                        	                            	                        </ul>                
                    </div><!--End questionCat-->
        	            	        </div><!--End questionList-->
